passages.text: The Deets on Our Sheets At Brooklinen, we’ve partnered with high-quality manufacturers throughout the world to make the best bedding in the game. We produce products in Portugal, Germany, Turkey, Pakistan, India, China (mainly for silk products), Peru, Canada, and the USA. With raw materials being sourced from all over the world, how do we keep your comfort at that top-notch quality? Well, Brooklinen is dedicated to ensuring that all suppliers of Brooklinen products, and the factories at which those goods are produced, are committed to and compliant with the highest standards of social compliance, safety, and ethical labor practices.

Do Good. Feel Good. Good 360 Logo Brooklinen Logo Not only do our sheets feel good, but they do good, too. We partner with Good360 to distribute any returned product to donation centers across the country. We want everyone to be comfortable. So we do what we can to help those who may not have the means or access to household essentials like sheets, towels, and more. And not only humans deserve comfort—we’ve partnered with Animal Haven to provide them with sheets to create cozy makeshift beds for the animals in their shelters.

Early recommendations and blogger outreach gave way to structured creator campaigns, product collaborations, paid social testing, and celebrity-led advertising. Each format gives a different answer to the question a bedding brand faces online: why should someone trust a product they cannot touch yet? In this Brand Story, we’ll trace Brooklinen’s growth from its Kickstarter launch to its latest product relaunch, examine the distinct roles of creators and partners, and show how its social content connects product discovery to purchase decisions and repeat buying. * How Brooklinen Made Premium Sheets Easier to Buy * Customer Recommendations and Early Creators Expanded Brooklinen’s Reach
